# Commands

Every built-in command. Menus, the toolbar, shortcuts, the [command palette](../command-palette.md), [plugins](../plugin-api.md) and [MCP clients](../mcp.md) all run commands by these ids. Commands marked *hidden* are not listed in the palette; they need arguments and are run from menus, plugins or MCP.
